→How I work

Research, build, test, teach.

Every project starts with the problem and the people who have it. I prototype early in hardware or code, measure it against real data, and write down what I learn so the next person can build on it.

The same habit carries into my talks and training sessions. If I cannot explain a system plainly, I do not understand it well enough yet.
